policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: advance Syrian visitor visa
policies.summary: Ireland's current passport-specific advice establishes that Irish citizens are visa-liable, and Syria's current entry rule requires non-exempt visitors to obtain the visa from a diplomatic mission in advance.
conditions: Ordinary Irish passport and short visitor travel only; an Irish passport card is not valid for the journey.
Obtain the entry visa from a Syrian diplomatic mission before travel; the current Syrian rule separately exempts qualifying transit passengers and crew.
Security, dual-national treatment, document validity and final admission remain separate from the normalized issuance route.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: advance Turkmenistan visitor visa
policies.summary: Ireland's current passport-specific advice requires Irish citizens to obtain a visa and invitation, directs them to the Turkmen Embassy, and expressly excludes visa on arrival.
conditions: Ordinary Irish passport and short visitor travel only; passport cards cannot be used.
Obtain the visa and State Migration Service-approved invitation before travel through the Turkmen Embassy route identified by Ireland's Department of Foreign Affairs.
Transit visas, restricted-area permits, local registration, dual-national treatment and final admission remain separate conditions.

conflicts.explanation: Current Irish guidance makes Irish citizens visa-liable, and Syria's current entry rule requires the visa from a diplomatic mission before travel unless exempt.

unresolved.reason: Ukraine's current matrix directly disproves ordinary-passport visa-free access but does not establish one safe advance, electronic or arrival issuance route.
